text.p: Sembawang Maritime Ltd said on Tuesday it had entered a joint venture agreement with Metro Holdings Ltd and Choo Teck Wong to own and operate cruise ships and related services and products.
The joint venture company would have an authorised share capital of Singapore $60 million and an initial paid up capital of S$9.6 million, the company said in a statement.
The issued share capital would be increased to S$60 million by September 1997. Sembawang will have a 27 percent stake in the JV while Metro will have 67 percent, it said.

The joint venture would accept the assignment from Metro of an agreement entered between Metro and Fourth Transoceanic Shipping Co Ltd in February 1997 for the acquisition of the "SS Meridian" for US$62.15 million.
Leveraging on the expertise of Sembawang, the joint venture will operate cruise ships around the region, the statement said.
